description: ATP1A2 LoF constraint versus other alpha isoforms and predicted biallelic-LoF birth prevalence from gnomAD v4
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, time, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import chi2

def gql(q, tries=6):
    for a in range(tries):
        try:
            r = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query":q}, timeout=180)
            if r.status_code==200 and r.text.strip().startswith("{"):
                return r.json()
        except Exception as e:
            pass
        time.sleep(6)
    raise RuntimeError("gnomAD fetch failed")

# ---- constraint for alpha isoforms ----
rows=[]
for g in ["ATP1A1","ATP1A2","ATP1A3","ATP1A4"]:
    j = gql('{gene(gene_symbol:"%s",reference_genome:GRCh38){gnomad_constraint{obs_lof exp_lof oe_lof oe_lof_lower oe_lof_upper pLI mis_z oe_mis}}}' % g)
    rows.append({"gene":g, **j["data"]["gene"]["gnomad_constraint"]})
    time.sleep(2)
con = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("gene")
print(con.to_string())

# ---- variants ----
qv = '{gene(gene_symbol:"ATP1A2",reference_genome:GRCh38){variants(dataset:gnomad_r4){variant_id consequence hgvsp lof exome{ac an filters} genome{ac an filters}}}}'
V = pd.DataFrame(gql(qv)["data"]["gene"]["variants"])
def ac_an(row):
    ac=0; an=0
    for k in ("exome","genome"):
        d=row.get(k)
        if d and not d.get("filters"):
            ac += d.get("ac") or 0; an = max(an, d.get("an") or 0)
    return pd.Series({"ac":ac,"an":an})
V = pd.concat([V, V.apply(ac_an,axis=1)],axis=1)

LOF_CSQ={"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_donor_variant","splice_acceptor_variant","start_lost"}
plof=V[V["consequence"].isin(LOF_CSQ)&(V["an"]>0)].copy(); plof["af"]=plof["ac"]/plof["an"]
hc=plof[plof["lof"]=="HC"].copy()
cum_hc=hc["af"].sum(); cum_all=plof["af"].sum()
print(f"\npLoF n={len(plof)} (HC={len(hc)}), max AN={plof['an'].max():,.0f}")
print(f"cumulative pLoF AF: HC={cum_hc:.3e}  all={cum_all:.3e}")
for lab,q in [("HC pLoF",cum_hc),("all pLoF",cum_all)]:
    carrier=2*q*(1-q); birth=q**2
    print(f"{lab}: carrier 1 in {1/carrier:,.0f}; predicted biallelic birth prevalence 1 in {1/birth:,.0f} ({birth*1e6:.4f} per 1,000,000)")
k=int(hc["ac"].sum()); AN=int(hc["an"].max())
lo=chi2.ppf(0.025,2*k)/2/AN; hi=chi2.ppf(0.975,2*(k+1))/2/AN
print(f"HC pLoF AC={k}/AN={AN:,}; q 95% CI ({lo:.2e},{hi:.2e}) -> prevalence 1 in {1/hi**2:,.0f} to 1 in {1/lo**2:,.0f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
order=["ATP1A1","ATP1A3","ATP1A2","ATP1A4"]
cols=["#4C72B0","#4C72B0","#C44E52","#9E9E9E"]
ax.bar(order,[con.loc[x,"oe_lof"] for x in order],color=cols)
for i,x in enumerate(order):
    ax.plot([i,i],[con.loc[x,"oe_lof_lower"],con.loc[x,"oe_lof_upper"]],c="k",lw=1.5)
    ax.text(i,con.loc[x,"oe_lof_upper"]+0.05,f"pLI={con.loc[x,'pLI']:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.axhline(1,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.25); ax.set_ylabel("observed / expected pLoF")
ax.set_title("gnomAD v4 LoF constraint, Na,K-ATPase alpha isoforms")

ax=axes[1]
hs=hc.sort_values("af",ascending=False).head(12)
labs=[(h.replace("p.","") if isinstance(h,str) else v) for h,v in zip(hs["hgvsp"],hs["variant_id"])]
y=np.arange(len(hs))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,hs["af"]*1e5,color="#C44E52")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(labs,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("allele frequency per 100,000")
ax.set_title(f"ATP1A2 high-confidence pLoF alleles in gnomAD v4\n(n={len(hc)}, cumulative q={cum_hc:.1e})")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
